newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy sees double-digit '97 net growth.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy sees double-digit '97 net growth.

text.p: KN Energy Inc said Tuesday its first quarter results put the company on track to achieve double-digit earnings growth in 1997.

"We have set ambitious goals for KN Energy in 1997 and, just as we did last year, we intend to continue to add value in all facets of our business," said KN Energy chairman and chief executive officer Larry Hall. "Our first quarter results are on track of achieve double-digit earnings growth in 1997."
KN Energy on Tuesday reported net income rose in the first quarter of 1997 to $20.4 million, or $0.65 a share, from $17.5 million, or $0.60 per share, in the same period a year earlier.
